pr_title: Fix "omit barline" sometimes not applying correctly
pr_body:
This is an alternative to #22582, which increases the scope of change but reduces the complexity.

Taken from that PR:

> In stable, inherited points cannot set the omit barline effect, the checkbox is grayed out.
> Usually, inherited points would inherit the omit barline effect setting from its uninherited parent, but this is not always the case, as with [the map in the aforementioned issue](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/1770207#taiko/3625974)
>
> It contains these two lines
> ```
> 11992,228.136882129278,4,1,0,90,1,8
> 11992,-136.979166666667,4,1,0,90,0,0
> ```

By moving the specification to the more correct location of `TimingControlPoint`, we can resolve this issue without too much extra thought.

- Closes #22551.
- Supersedes and closes #22582.
pr_comments: @sw1tchbl4d3r Please take a look at this and see how it looks to you. During RL discussion it was touched on that the previous PR was very complicated to understand and review. I think this approach feels better (and is a better direction in terms of exposing the setting to the user in the editor).

This is definitely the better approach, was worried a sudden change of a property like this might break older lazer-made maps that rely on the property being part of the effect point, but this still needs some work in the editor, in particular this:
![barline](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/54949148/221872627-70a661c8-cad9-4b07-97aa-cc5a9d6f6d1e.png)

The full info "badge" gets too long to fit in the section and gets moved downwards, which results in this weird displaying of the property.
I've fixed the layout issue with this one, so it should be good to go.

@bdach if you're confident it's likely fine to go ahead and merge. the RL discussion was mostly very shallow smoogi:"other PR is complex" me:"yeah but i think i have a cleaner alternative let me do that instead".

issue_context.title: Barlines doesn't hide
issue_context.body: ### Type Game behaviour ### Bug description In this map: https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/1770207#taiko/3625974 (Antti's Oni) Barlines at around 00:11:757 show while they are hidden in Stable ### Screenshots or videos The barlines without hit objects on them are hidden in stable ### Version 2023.207.0 ### Logs [database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10684405/database.log) [network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10684406/network.log) [performance-draw.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10684407/performance-draw.log) [performance-update.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10684408/performance-update.log) [performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10684409/performance.log) [runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10684411/runtime.log)

review_comments: Of note, this is a subtler-than-apparent change which makes it so that if the problematic beatmap mentioned in the issue is re-exported using lazer's editor, it will auto-fix itself, as in the problematic inherited point will have the omit bar line flag set after export. Which is neat, but also technically breaks import-export stability. But I think that's fine.
